msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia nanmar-perfumes-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury beauty campaign still life of a pale pink and gold perfume bottle with a sculpted gold cap, wrapped in torn peach paper with vanilla pods and caramel from the reference. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm cinematic light, rich textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia nanmar-perfumes-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of two perfume bottles side by side, one gold and one black, each wrapped by a sculpted metal snake from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia nanmar-perfumes-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a pink perfume bottle with a tall pink cap, with strawberries and cream around it from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia nanmar-perfumes-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a brown and bronze perfume bottle with a dark cap, in torn paper with dark chocolate from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia nanmar-perfumes-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a clear glass perfume bottle with pale blue liquid and a black cap from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail.
